channel.title: JustJayDev — Devlog
channel.description: Build notes for JustJayDev: the site, TitleForge, PixVault and the Developer Vault.

item.title: v7 — the site rebuilt from scratch
item.description: A ground-up rebuild on a new architecture and visual identity. New token system, a real content layer, and type-checking that actually blocks the build.

item.title: Authenticated password-rotate route added to the Vault
item.description: The Vault can now rotate its own admin password through an authenticated route instead of a redeploy.

item.title: PixVault admin rebuilt as a dashboard
item.description: Upload management, health checks and orphaned-wallpaper recovery in one place instead of a raw admin form.

item.title: TitleForge forge proxy + title:forge policy live in the Vault
item.description: The AI key now decrypts inside the Vault under a scoped policy. It has never been in the repo or the browser bundle.

item.title: The Roblox banner finally loaded
item.description: The file was SVG content saved with a .png extension, so GitHub served it as image/png and every browser refused to render it.

item.title: Command palette, achievements, and a 404 that behaves
item.description: Cmd/Ctrl+K to jump anywhere, a visitor achievement system, and dead URLs that land on a real 404 instead of a blank screen.

item.title: The revamp: command palette, achievements, cinematic hero
item.description: A big visual pass. Animated mesh-gradient backdrop, a character-by-character title reveal, and a proper 404.

item.title: Developer Vault — the credential control plane
item.description: One secure backend holding every project secret, so no API key ever has to live in a browser bundle.

item.title: TitleForge skeleton shipped
item.description: The four-step flow works end to end: connect your channel, load videos, forge titles, review and apply.

item.title: Dead code cleanup + verified stats
item.description: Removed an unused guestbook component and five dead CSS classes, and re-verified every number on the site.

item.title: The overnight polish sprint
item.description: Scroll progress, back-to-top, typewriter taglines, a stats strip, live search, copy-link buttons and per-page titles.

item.title: The lean rebuild — 16 pages down to 3
item.description: Home, Games and About. Every page lazy-loaded, Firebase and thirteen unused pages removed.

item.title: The site moved to the domain root
item.description: Four old repositories deleted, one repo renamed to JustJayDev.github.io, and every path config migrated in a single pass.

item.title: New hero: the motto wall
item.description: The homepage hero became the motto wallpaper — "A King Never Wavers" — with a new OG share image and PWA icon.

item.title: PixVault — a wallpaper library with no signup wall
item.description: Original-resolution HD and 4K wallpapers, free, no watermark, and no account required to download.

item.title: Every page made lazy
item.description: All sixteen pages were loading in one bundle. Now every page is code-split with React.lazy.

item.title: Site v2 is live — and the QR code works
item.description: PWA offline support, animated stats, glare-tilt cards, magnetic buttons, a glitch 404 and a real scannable QR in the footer.

item.title: justjaydev.github.io — this site is now my main home
item.description: Promoted to the main GitHub Pages home. The URL is now just the bare domain, with no subfolder.

item.title: Next phase: autonomous build and polish
item.description: A working plan for keeping the projects shipping without each one needing a fresh decision.
